annotations.title: Decide before paying an x402 endpoint

description: Decision for one x402 payment, made right before it is signed. Pass the endpoint url and the 402 it returned (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value or JSON body), optionally max_usd. Optional client: the x402 library and version (e.g. @x402/fetch@2.22.1): known payment flaws come back in client_advisories (not logged). Each payment option gets allow / hold / block with reasons: block: pay_to_unknown, pay_to_sanctioned, pay_to_frozen_by_issuer, service_not_working, over_budget; hold: pay_to_differs_from_listing, pay_to_never_seen, price_above_listing, price_above_observed, network_not_listed, asset_not_stablecoin, high_price, unknown_service, not_checked_yet, not_rated_yet, low_trust_score; info: pay_to_as_observed, pay_to_platform_wallet, amount_is_ceiling (scheme upto), frozen_status_unknown, testnet. The decision is signed, bound to the payment hash, logged, and valid for 5 minutes. allow: no problem found; hold: something the user should confirm; block: a problem that should stop the payment. Docs: https://alalanet.com/skill.md.

client.description: optional: your x402 client library and version, e.g. @x402/fetch@2.22.1 or pypi:x402@2.19.0; alalanet warns about versions with known payment flaws (not logged)

max_usd.description: your budget for this one call in US dollars; options above it are blocked

payment_required.description: the 402 the endpoint returned: x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value (base64) or JSON body, or an MPP WWW-Authenticate: Payment value; omit to judge the terms alalanet last observed

url.description: https URL of the x402 endpoint you are about to pay
